headline: Binance investigates possible multibillion-dollar crypto theft
summary: Binance, the cryptocurrency exchange, is investigating a security breach in which hackers are suspected of stealing a large sum of crypto, with one outlet citing an estimate of up to $5.8 billion. One report says the attack happened Thursday and that Binance paused withdrawals in response; another says it could be the largest cryptocurrency hack ever.
